title: Squid Dosa
description: A spicy seafood twist on traditional Indian dosas. Crispy dosa wraps filled with tender squid.

ingredients.name: Squid
ingredients.notes: Cleaned and cut into small pieces

instructions: Soak the rice flour and urad dal in water for 4 hours.
Drain and grind the mixture into a smooth batter.
Heat a non-stick pan and brush with oil.
Pour a ladleful of the dosa batter and spread into a circle.
Cook for 1 minute, then flip and cook for another minute.
In a separate pan, heat oil and sauté the squid until cooked through.
Add the chopped onion, curry leaves, ginger paste, and garlic to the pan and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the chili powder and mix well.
To assemble the dosa, place a cooked dosa on a plate, add a spoonful of the squid mixture, and roll up.
Serve with lemon juice and enjoy!
